adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh call now goes through `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. When credential sync is enabled, `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the response from `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), which is documented to return only an access token and expiry. However, the Lark implementation still passes that response into `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, ...)`, which is intended for Lark’s refresh endpoint response format. Unlike other integrations in the diff (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom) that add `parseRefreshTokenResponse` to accept a minimal token schema, Lark’s parsing path is unchanged, so a minimal sync response is likely to fail parsing/handling or produce incorrect derived values.
